app_info.subtitle: Supplier catalogues and orders
app_info.description: Connect your TradeCatalog account to set up a supplier workspace, search products at your agreed prices, prepare orders and manage catalogues. For businesses supplying bakery, food, IT, office, beauty, cleaning, building and other products, from one-person suppliers to teams. Buyers use their own customer accounts. Staff manage products, customer terms, price changes, orders, news and support. Owner controls stay owner-only. Consequential changes show a confirmation card before they run; clients without cards use a signed-in review. Credential creation and file uploads finish securely in TradeCatalog.

test_cases.description: Buyer selects their review account and looks up a visible product.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show my TradeCatalog accounts, then find HX-8510 at the price for my selected account.
test_cases.expected_output: An explicit choice between the buyer's Acme Building Supplies and Oakfield Joinery accounts, then the selected account's price in GBP and the hex bolt details. Products restricted to another customer account and another tenant’s IDs must not disclose data.

test_cases.description: Buyer prepares an order and confirms it inside ChatGPT.
test_cases.user_prompt: Put two HX-8510 in my Acme Building Supplies basket and prepare an order with PO OPENAI-REVIEW. Let me review before sending.
test_cases.tools_triggered: list_workspaces, search_products, set_basket_quantity, get_basket, send_order, get_action_status
test_cases.expected_output: An in-chat review card with the chosen account, products, quantities and total before any order is sent. Clicking Confirm executes once and returns the placed order reference. Cancel sends no order. Clients without cards receive a signed-in review link. A changed basket, expired review, disconnected grant or repeated confirmation must not send an extra or unreviewed order.

test_cases.description: Staff prepares a percentage price draft without publishing.
test_cases.user_prompt: Draft a 5% increase for my supplier catalogue and show the impact. Do not publish it.
test_cases.expected_output: An unpublished draft and its impact. No customer emails or published prices.

test_cases.description: Staff uses individually exposed product edits, hide, show, move and delete operations with separate human reviews.
test_cases.user_prompt: In my review catalogue, work through HX-8510 one step at a time: change its description to Review test hex bolt, hide it, make it active again, then remove its category while keeping its prices. Let me review each change separately. Finally prepare a permanent deletion for review, but I will choose Cancel.
test_cases.tools_triggered: list_workspaces, search_products, get_product, save_product, hide_products, show_products, move_products, delete_products, get_action_status
test_cases.expected_output: Read the current product and retain its ID throughout. Preserve other fields when using save_product. Each subsequent step uses its own listed tool, exact product ID and separate confirmation: hide_products retains data, show_products preserves customer restrictions, and move_products with categoryId null retains the product and prices. delete_products displays permanent-deletion consequences, but Cancel leaves the product, prices, images and basket lines intact. No arbitrary operation or generic dispatcher is available; read-only grants cannot prepare these writes.

test_cases.description: Owner uses separately exposed settings, export, import, logo, product image and product file handoffs without disclosing secrets or claiming completed changes.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show my workspace settings and API-key labels. Give me the signed-in pages for creating an API key, downloading the workspace export, uploading a logo and importing a catalogue file. Also show where I can upload an image and manage spec sheets for HX-8510.
test_cases.tools_triggered: list_workspaces, get_settings, list_api_keys, search_products, get_product, open_api_key_settings, download_workspace_export, open_logo_settings, open_import_page, open_product_image_upload, open_product_file_manager
test_cases.expected_output: Return non-secret settings and key metadata, then use a separate listed tool for each handoff. API settings, full exports and logo settings require ownership; verify a staff-only identity is denied those three owner tools. The image and file tools require the selected workspace’s existing product ID and reject another tenant’s product. Links require signed-in access; do not claim credentials were created, an export transferred, files read or removed, or uploads/imports completed. No subscription checkout is exposed.

negative_test_cases.description: The user wants a personal retail purchase from an unrelated marketplace.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Find the cheapest cordless drill on Amazon for my home and buy it.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Do not invoke TradeCatalog. It manages existing trade supplier accounts, not public retail shopping.

negative_test_cases.description: The user wants to collect or refund a card payment.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Charge my customer’s credit card for their invoice and refund the previous charge.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Do not invoke TradeCatalog. The plugin does not process card charges or refunds.

negative_test_cases.description: The user wants to purchase or upgrade a software subscription.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Upgrade my TradeCatalog subscription and pay for the annual plan.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Do not invoke TradeCatalog tools or direct to subscription checkout. Subscription purchases and upgrades are outside the plugin.
